preconditions.description: The number of pillars is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The absolute difference threshold is between 0 and 10^9, inclusive.
The height of each pillar is between 1 and 10^15, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output length of the jump sequence is the maximum possible length.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(h[sequence[i]] - h[sequence[i+1]]) >= d for i in 1..output_length-1)
postconditions.description: The difference between the heights of consecutive pillars in the output sequence is at least d.
The output sequence contains unique pillar indices.

postconditions.expression: sequence == any(sequence for sequence in all_sequences if len(sequence) == output_length)
postconditions.description: The output sequence is one of the maximal length sequences.
